name: shared-database-discipline
description: Rules for running one shared Postgres/MongoDB behind many projects instead of a database container per repo: per-environment isolation enforced with REVOKE rather than convention, a three-role credential model where apps never run as owner, connection-string formats that silently break (Npgsql rejects postgresql:// URIs; semicolon values must not be shell-sourced), and self-hosted-runner deploy safety.
